declared_exceptions.detail: Priya Nandakumar is active but nandakumar_headshot.jpg was not supplied. Her card is a photo-free conditional proof. No other person's image was substituted; the combined run must not go to press without owner approval.

Miller Text Roman was not supplied as a usable local font. Georgia Regular is substituted for license, office and disclosure text. Lexend SemiBold and IBM Plex Sans Regular are retained locally with their open-source licenses.

Miguel Reyes's supplied portrait included Pinebrook Savings signage. An Adobe image_instruct_edit output removed that background sign; the original, Adobe PNG, and final crop are retained for review. No replacement person or invented headshot was used.

No auto or human benchmark verifier scores were used as a release gate, per the user's instruction. File integrity and copy binding were checked separately; creative and compliance approval remain pending.
